objective: discover a sustainable after-cost ML alpha from completed Uniswap WETH-stable inventory transfer before Bybit ETHUSDT structural delivery, without using pre-2024 purity gates to postpone the first official 2024H1 research interval

information_unit.primary_source: SQD public Ethereum Portal finalized canonical Swap logs
information_unit.aggregation: completed UTC one-hour signed amount0/amount1 inventory transfer
information_unit.direction: amount0 positive and amount1 negative is completed WETH purchase pressure; the opposite signs are completed WETH sale pressure
information_unit.source_gate: complete signed stream from 2021-07-01 through 2023-12-31 plus two frozen small 2024H1 continuity probes; the complete 2024H1 stream stays unopened until the pre-2024 system is frozen
information_unit.known_limitation: the public Portal is rate-limited; the client must preserve cursor continuity and immutable event identities, and any incomplete stream retires the source rather than imputing it

execution.entry: next exact contiguous five-minute open after delayed completed-hour decision
execution.exit: frozen external-liquidity target, frozen structural stop or explicit structural invalidation only
execution.risk_selection: highest 24-bp geometric daily growth among no-liquidation paths; 1% is not a cap and winner-removal remains a reported diagnostic rather than a pre-2024 opening barrier

official_sequential_research.weak_2024H1_action: retire this information unit and change alpha rather than tune adjacent thresholds, features, risk or leverage
official_sequential_research.promising_2024H1_action: use information available through 2024-06-30 to freeze the predetermined update method for 2024H2
official_sequential_research.seen_interval_rule: an inspected interval may inform the next version but is never relabeled as fresh independent OOS for that modified version
